# Original saved layouts and download repair

`generate_project_slot_import_fixtures.py` invokes validated original app code
objects and the active PS/variant patch with synthetic layers. Its manifest hash
uses LF-normalized text. Original includes, scale fallback, duplicate job keys,
blank slots, ordering, PS numbers and variants are compared with native restore.
Unknown slot payloads remain in the unchanged archive. Exact original slot
indices keep different blank-slot metadata separate during active conversion.

Native preferences retain raster, virtual and blank slots through save/read and
reordering. Imported virtual sources also carry their existing archive identity,
so renaming a source or duplicate job/name pairs cannot retarget a reviewed slot.
The ordinary template menu uses this restored mixed layout. General/project
export settings remain effective until a reviewed export captures native choices.
New raster-only choices can export imagery without inventing a measurement job.

`generate_kickthemap_strategy_fixtures.py` executes original AST-selected pure
request/template methods and a fake-session response parser. It compares three
job-name/template cases and seven custom-response/fallback cases. Native local
HTTP tests check GET/POST, custom endpoints, CSRF refresh and ordinary fallback.
Repair promotes a strategy only after a fresh sample has valid spatial metadata
and bounded readable pixels; a TIFF signature alone is insufficient. Failures
retain the previous strategy and sample files.

The desktop can import an existing bounded UTF-8 capture for one selected job.
It uses the exact current session/job owner, existing cancellation/generation
guards and normal validated-file loading. Only request templates are persisted,
in native storage scoped to the immutable authenticated owner. Browser sessions
with unknown identity retain their separate random owner. No original account,
strategy or browser-profile files are opened.

Automatic arming/capture of a manual request in the owned browser, all original
fallback/account variants, ambiguous duplicate physical raster paths, automatic
profile-data hydration for every restored source, and real-project/provider
acceptance remain open. This evidence does not close the full conversion or
KickTheMap package.
